SELECT
    t1.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    t1.artname AS artifact_name,
    t4.insvalueusd AS insured_value,
    CAST(t1.conservestatus AS TEXT) AS conservation_status,
    t3.researchvalrating AS value_category
FROM
    artifactscore AS t1
JOIN
    artifactsecurityaccess AS t4
        ON t1.artregistry = t4.artref
JOIN
    artifactratings AS t3
        ON t1.artregistry = t3.artref
JOIN
    riskassessments AS t5
        ON t1.artregistry = t5.artrefconcerned
WHERE
    t5.emergresponseplan ILIKE '%emergency%'
    AND CAST(t1.conservestatus AS TEXT) ILIKE '%serious%'

SELECT 
    a.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    a.artname AS artifact_name,
    s.showcasematerial, 
    s.sealcondition, 
    s.maintstatus, 
    s.filterstatus, 
    s.silicagelstatus, 
    s.silicagelchangedate, 
    s.humiditybuffercap, 
    s.pollutantabsorbcap, 
    s.leakrate, 
    s.pressurepa, 
    s.inertgassysstatus, 
    s.firesuppresssys, 
    s.empowerstatus, 
    s.backupsysstatus,
    COUNT(sd.sensitivityregistry) AS sensitive_factors,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.artregistry IN (
            SELECT artref 
            FROM artifactratings 
            WHERE deteriorrate = 'Rapid'
        ) THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM 
    artifactscore a
JOIN 
    artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata sd ON a.artregistry = sd.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords ur ON a.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
JOIN 
    showcases s ON ca.showcaserefexamined = s.showcasereg
WHERE 
    ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid'
GROUP BY 
    a.artregistry, a.artname, s.showcasematerial, s.sealcondition, s.maintstatus, s.filterstatus, s.silicagelstatus, s.silicagelchangedate, s.humiditybuffercap, s.pollutantabsorbcap, s.leakrate, s.pressurepa, s.inertgassysstatus, s.firesuppresssys, s.empowerstatus, s.backupsysstatus;

SELECT 
    ar.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ar.artname AS artifact_name,
    ar.conservestatus AS conservation_status,
    at.deteriorrate AS deterioration_rate,
    sc.showcasematerial AS display_case_material,
    sc.sealcondition AS seal_condition,
    sc.maintstatus AS maintenance_status,
    sc.filterstatus AS filter_status,
    sc.silicagelstatus AS silica_gel_status,
    sc.silicagelchangedate AS silica_gel_change_date,
    sc.humiditybuffercap AS humidity_buffer_capacity,
    sc.pollutantabsorbcap AS pollutant_absorb_capacity,
    sc.leakrate AS leak_rate,
    sc.pressurepa AS pressure,
    sc.inertgassysstatus AS inert_gas_system_status,
    sc.firesuppresssys AS fire_suppression_system,
    sc.empowerstatus AS emergency_power_status,
    sc.backupsysstatus AS backup_system_status,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM sensitivitydata sd
        WHERE sd.artref = ar.artregistry
        AND (
            sd.envsensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.lightsensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.tempsensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.humiditysensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.vibrasensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.pollutantsensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.pestsensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.handlesensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.transportsensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.displaysensitivity IS NOT NULL
            OR sd.storagesensitivity IS NOT NULL
        )
    ) AS sensitive_factors_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN at.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM 
    artifactscore ar
JOIN 
    artifactratings at ON ar.artregistry = at.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords ur ON ar.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    showcases sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg;

5e69462ef914a2aa18466c7e075a9fbb223f6994.sql:
SELECT 
    ar.deteriorrate AS rapid_deterioration,
    ac.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ac.artname AS artifact_name,
    sc.showcasematerial AS display_case_material,
    sc.sealcondition AS seal_condition,
    sc.maintstatus AS maintenance_status,
    sc.filterstatus AS filter_status,
    sc.silicagelstatus AS silica_gel_status,
    sc.silicagelchangedate AS silica_gel_change_date,
    sc.humiditybuffercap AS humidity_buffer_capacity,
    sc.pollutantabsorbcap AS pollutant_absorb_capacity,
    sc.leakrate AS leak_rate,
    sc.pressurepa AS pressure,
    sc.inertgassysstatus AS inert_gas_system_status,
    sc.firesuppresssys AS fire_suppression_system,
    sc.empowerstatus AS emergency_power_status,
    sc.backupsysstatus AS backup_system_status,
    (
        CASE WHEN sd.envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS sensitive_factors_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS accelerated_deterioration_criteria
FROM 
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN 
    artifactratings AS ar ON ac.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords AS ur ON ac.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    showcases AS sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ar.deteriorrate AS rapid_deterioration,
    ac.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ac.artname AS artifact_name,
    sh.showcasematerial, sh.sealcondition, sh.maintstatus, sh.filterstatus, sh.silicagelstatus, sh.silicagelchangedate, sh.humiditybuffercap, sh.pollutantabsorbcap, sh.leakrate, sh.pressurepa, sh.inertgassysstatus, sh.firesuppresssys, sh.empowerstatus, sh.backupsysstatus AS display_case_conditions,
    COUNT(sd.sensitivityregistry) AS sensitive_factors,
    CASE 
        WHEN ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS meets_accelerated_deterioration
FROM 
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN 
    artifactratings AS ar ON ac.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords AS ur ON ac.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    conditionassessments AS ca ON ac.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
JOIN 
    showcases AS sh ON ca.showcaserefexamined = sh.showcasereg
GROUP BY 
    ar.deteriorrate, ac.artregistry, ac.artname, sh.showcasematerial, sh.sealcondition, sh.maintstatus, sh.filterstatus, sh.silicagelstatus, sh.silicagelchangedate, sh.humiditybuffercap, sh.pollutantabsorbcap, sh.leakrate, sh.pressurepa, sh.inertgassysstatus, sh.firesuppresssys, sh.empowerstatus, sh.backupsysstatus;

SELECT 
    ra.artrefconcerned AS artifact_id,
    TETL.tetl_score
FROM 
    riskassessments ra
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        artrefconcerned,
        SUM(
            conservepriorityscore * 
            CASE 
                WHEN riskassesslevel = 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN riskassesslevel = 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN riskassesslevel = 'Low' THEN 1
            END
        ) AS tetl_score
    FROM 
        riskassessments
    GROUP BY 
        artrefconcerned
) AS TETL ON ra.artrefconcerned = TETL.artrefconcerned
ORDER BY 
    tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH ArtifactRiskFactors AS (
    SELECT
        artregistry AS artifact_id,
        artname AS artifact_name,
        ARRAY[
            envsensitivity,
            lightsensitivity,
            tempsensitivity,
            humiditysensitivity,
            vibrasensitivity,
            pollutantsensitivity,
            pestsensitivity,
            handlesensitivity,
            transportsensitivity,
            displaysensitivity,
            storagesensitivity
        ] AS sensitivities,
        (
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN envsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) / 11
        ) AS risk_factor
    FROM
        sensitivitydata
        JOIN artifactscore ON sensitivitydata.artref = artifactscore.artregistry
    GROUP BY
        artregistry,
        artname,
        envsensitivity,
        lightsensitivity,
        tempsensitivity,
        humiditysensitivity,
        vibrasensitivity,
        pollutantsensitivity,
        pestsensitivity,
        handlesensitivity,
        transportsensitivity,
        displaysensitivity,
        storagesensitivity
)
SELECT
    artifact_id,
    artifact_name,
    risk_factor,
    json_agg(sensitivities) AS sensitivity_ratings
FROM
    ArtifactRiskFactors
WHERE
    risk_factor > 7
GROUP BY
    artifact_id,
    artifact_name,
    risk_factor
ORDER BY
    risk_factor DESC;

WITH DynastyArtifactInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        a.artregistry AS ArtifactID,
        a.conservestatus AS ConservationStatus,
        cm.budgetallocstatus AS BudgetAllocStatus,
        cm.maintbudgetstatus AS MaintenanceBudgetStatus,
        ra.conservepriorityscore AS PriorityScore,
        ar.conservediff AS ConservationDifficulty
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    LEFT JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    LEFT JOIN 
        riskassessments ra ON a.artregistry = ra.artrefconcerned
    LEFT JOIN 
        artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
),
DynastySummary AS (
    SELECT 
        Dynasty,
        SUM(PriorityScore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        SUM(CASE WHEN BudgetAllocStatus ILIKE '%adequate%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN BudgetAllocStatus ILIKE '%insufficient%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        -- Assuming BudgetEfficiencyValue is derived from MaintenanceBudgetStatus
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(MaintenanceBudgetStatus) ILIKE '%limited%' THEN 0.6
            WHEN MAX(MaintenanceBudgetStatus) ILIKE '%depleted%' THEN 0.3
            ELSE 1.0
        END AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(MaintenanceBudgetStatus) ILIKE '%depleted%' AND MAX(BudgetAllocStatus) ILIKE '%insufficient%' THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyArtifactInfo
    GROUP BY 
        Dynasty
),
AllDynastiesSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS Dynasty,
        SUM(TotalPriorityScore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END) AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastySummary
)
SELECT 
    ds.Dynasty, 
    ds.TotalPriorityScore, 
    ds.AdequateFundingCount AS "Artifacts with Adequate Funding", 
    ds.InsufficientFundingCount AS "Artifacts with Insufficient Funding", 
    ds.BudgetEfficiencyValue, 
    ds.BudgetStatus
FROM 
    DynastySummary ds
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    ads.Dynasty, 
    ads.TotalPriorityScore, 
    ads.AdequateFundingCount AS "Artifacts with Adequate Funding", 
    ads.InsufficientFundingCount AS "Artifacts with Insufficient Funding", 
    ads.BudgetEfficiencyValue, 
    ads.BudgetStatus
FROM 
    AllDynastiesSummary ads;

54816e4905d31361798d199e64b015397bd3b43b.sql:
WITH DynastyBudget AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS DynastyName,
        SUM(r.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus = 'Available' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus != 'Available' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus = 'Available' THEN 1 END) < COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus != 'Available' THEN 1 END) 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        riskassessments r ON a.artregistry = r.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance c ON a.artregistry = c.artrefmaintained
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
SummaryBudget AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS DynastyName,
        SUM(TotalConservationPriorityIndex) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(AdequateFundingCount) < SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyBudget
)

SELECT * FROM DynastyBudget
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM SummaryBudget;

WITH SensitiveArtifacts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry, 
        t1.artname, 
        t1.mattype, 
        t2.lightsensitivity, 
        t3.lightlux
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artrefexamined
    JOIN 
        lightandradiationreadings AS t3 ON t4.lightreadrefobserved = t3.lightradregistry
    WHERE 
        t2.lightsensitivity ILIKE '%sensitive%'
),
LightExposureStatus AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry, 
        artname, 
        mattype, 
        lightsensitivity,
        lightlux,
        CASE 
            WHEN lightlux > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure' 
            ELSE 'Within Limits' 
        END AS exposure_status
    FROM 
        SensitiveArtifacts
)
SELECT 
    artregistry AS registry_number,
    artname AS name,
    mattype AS material_type,
    lightsensitivity AS light_sensitivity,
    exposure_status AS current_status
FROM 
    LightExposureStatus;

WITH max_light_sensitivity AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry, 
        MAX(lr.lightlux) AS max_light_lux
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
    JOIN 
        lightandradiationreadings lr ON ca.lightreadrefobserved = lr.lightradregistry
    GROUP BY 
        a.artregistry
),
artifact_info AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry, 
        a.artname, 
        a.mattype, 
        sd.lightsensitivity
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata sd ON a.artregistry = sd.artref
)
SELECT 
    ai.artregistry AS registry_number,
    ai.artname AS name,
    ai.mattype AS material_type,
    ai.lightsensitivity AS light_sensitivity,
    CASE 
        WHEN mls.max_light_lux > 1000 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS current_status
FROM 
    artifact_info ai
LEFT JOIN 
    max_light_sensitivity mls ON ai.artregistry = mls.artregistry;

c6df97cbba12ee08ea4106f808c6b02bb045b093.sql:
WITH sensitivity_summary AS (
    SELECT
        artref,
        json_build_object(
            'envsensitivity', envsensitivity,
            'lightsensitivity', lightsensitivity,
            'tempsensitivity', tempsensitivity,
            'humiditysensitivity', humiditysensitivity,
            'vibrasensitivity', vibrasensitivity,
            'pollutantsensitivity', pollutantsensitivity,
            'pestsensitivity', pestsensitivity,
            'handlesensitivity', handlesensitivity,
            'transportsensitivity', transportsensitivity,
            'displaysensitivity', displaysensitivity,
            'storagesensitivity', storagesensitivity
        ) AS sensitivity_json
    FROM sensitivitydata
),
risk_scores AS (
    SELECT
        artref,
        (
            (CASE WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END)
        ) / 11.0 AS risk_factor
    FROM sensitivitydata
)
SELECT
    a.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    a.artname AS artifact_name,
    r.risk_factor,
    s.sensitivity_json
FROM
    artifactscore a
JOIN
    risk_scores r ON a.artregistry = r.artref
JOIN
    sensitivity_summary s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
WHERE
    r.risk_factor > 7
ORDER BY
    r.risk_factor DESC;

WITH sensitivity_weights AS (
    SELECT 
        artref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN envsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS env_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS light_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS temp_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS humidity_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS vibra_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS pollutant_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS pest_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS handle_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS transport_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS display_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS storage_weight
    FROM sensitivitydata
),
risk_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry, 
        a.artname, 
        (
            sw.env_weight + sw.light_weight + sw.temp_weight + sw.humidity_weight + 
            sw.vibra_weight + sw.pollutant_weight + sw.pest_weight + sw.handle_weight + 
            sw.transport_weight + sw.display_weight + sw.storage_weight
        ) / 11.0 AS risk_score, 
        json_build_object(
            'envsensitivity', sw.env_weight,
            'lightsensitivity', sw.light_weight,
            'tempsensitivity', sw.temp_weight,
            'humiditysensitivity', sw.humidity_weight,
            'vibrasensitivity', sw.vibra_weight,
            'pollutantsensitivity', sw.pollutant_weight,
            'pestsensitivity', sw.pest_weight,
            'handlesensitivity', sw.handle_weight,
            'transportsensitivity', sw.transport_weight,
            'displaysensitivity', sw.display_weight,
            'storagesensitivity', sw.storage_weight
        ) AS sensitivity_ratings
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN sensitivity_weights sw ON a.artregistry = sw.artref
)
SELECT 
    artregistry, 
    artname, 
    risk_score, 
    sensitivity_ratings
FROM risk_scores
WHERE risk_score > 7
ORDER BY risk_score DESC;
